title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema setup --format json
description: Result of setting up the Foreign Data Wrapper from the target to the source: the postgres_fdw extension, the foreign server, the user mapping and, unless --skip-import, the source's public schema imported as foreign tables. The CLI assembles it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

skip_import.description: True when --skip-import was given: the server and user mapping exist, no foreign table was imported.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
